title: Best Marriott Bonvoy hotels in Thailand
intro: Thailand carries the largest Marriott Bonvoy footprint EliteStay tracks in Southeast Asia -- 56 hotels spanning Bangkok, the beach islands of Phuket and Ko Samui, the Gulf resorts of Pattaya, Rayong and Hua Hin, and northern Chiang Mai. The list below is ranked by our researched guest-quality score, from The Ritz-Carlton and Luxury Collection's flagship Bangkok properties down to Four Points and Marriott Executive Apartments' value-focused stays.
editorial_notes: Hand-drafted 2026-08-17 to seed the restored Best Of feature (see commit that reversed 4e2fc60). Intro/FAQ figures (hotel count, city list) verified against data/entities and data/regions/thailand.json at draft time -- re-check if the catalogue grows materially before this is regenerated.

faqs.question: How many Marriott Bonvoy hotels are there in Thailand?
faqs.answer: EliteStay currently tracks 56 Marriott Bonvoy hotels across Thailand, concentrated in Bangkok and Phuket with further properties in Ko Samui, Pattaya, Hua Hin, Chiang Mai, Krabi and Rayong. Coverage spans the full Bonvoy portfolio, from The Ritz-Carlton and The Luxury Collection to Marriott Executive Apartments and Four Points.

faqs.question: How is this list ranked?
faqs.answer: Hotels are ordered by EliteStay's guest-quality score -- the same score shown on every hotel's own page -- rather than a fixed editorial pick, so the ranking updates automatically as research on individual properties is refreshed.
